parts.content: Implement the plan-development-tasks workflow outputs for the ten attached user stories in d:\PropelExp: US_021..US_025 under EP-003 and US_026..US_030 under EP-004. Write task markdown files using apply_patch only, no shell/Python file writing. Use .propel/templates/task-template.md structure exactly (actual template was loaded via MCP in parent session; local stub points to MCP, so use these required sections: H1 Task; Requirement Reference; conditional Design References for UI only; conditional AI References for AI only; Applicable Technology Stack; Task Overview; Dependent Tasks; Impacted Components; Implementation Plan; Current Project State; Expected Changes; External References; Build Commands; Implementation Validation Strategy; Implementation Checklist). One task per layer. Generate Frontend and Backend tasks for every story, plus an AI task only for US_027, US_028, US_029 because they reference AIR-003/AIR-004. Thus 23 files. Each story folder currently has no task files; name task_001_<slug>-frontend.md, task_002_<slug>-backend.md, and task_003_<slug>-ai.md where applicable. Each task <=8 hours (state estimate in Task Overview), 1-8 checklist items, exactly one technology layer, and cover all story ACs across tasks. No unit-test implementation checklist items and no downstream workflow commands. Validation section may structurally mention unit/integration tests. Use locked stack from design.md: Frontend React 19.3, TypeScript 7.0, Vite 8.3; Backend Python 3.14.7, FastAPI 0.141.1, Pydantic 2.x, compatible Uvicorn; AI provider-neutral adapter contract v1 and JSON Schema 2020-12 with Pydantic 2.x. No database tasks. Repository is greenfield, so expected source operations are CREATE only and align to recommended structure under frontend/src/features/{extraction-review,poc-authoring} and backend/src/cms_planner/{api,domain,application,modules/review,modules/poc,adapters/ai}; avoid speculative excessive files (1-3 concrete source files per task). UI references: US021 SCR-004 wireframe-SCR-004-extraction-review.html UXR-102; US022 SCR-005 wireframe-SCR-005-uncertainty-resolution.html UXR-102,UXR-502; US023 SCR-004,SCR-005 Hi-Fi directory UXR-103; US024 SCR-004 wireframe SCR004 UXR-502; US025 SCR-004,SCR-005 Hi-Fi directory UXR-103,UXR-502; US026-030 SCR-006 wireframe-SCR-006-poc-authoring.html, UXR N/A. Figma URL N/A (no concrete URL found). Design tokens point to .propel/context/docs/designsystem.md relevant component/semantic token sections. AI refs: US027 AIR-003; US028/029 AIR-004; AI pattern provider-neutral structured generation with deterministic guardrails; prompt path prompts/poc/; guardrails backend/src/cms_planner/adapters/ai/guardrails.py; model provider runtime-selected BAA-approved LLM adapter. Build commands link .propel/build/. External refs use official version-pinned docs URLs where possible. Dependencies should reference story prerequisites and earlier same-story layer task where appropriate. Story source paths are the exact .propel/context/tasks/.../us_XXX.md files. Acceptance criteria and edge cases must faithfully reflect source. Do not add Mobile sections. Keep each file concise but complete. After the first files are edited, immediately run a focused structural validation, then continue. At end, validate all 23 files: existence, required headings, checklist count 1-8, no Database layer task, sequence/naming, AC coverage, and markdown parsing. Return a concise report of created paths and validation results; do not expose workflow prompt instructions.
